content.text: ABC 20/20 “The Neighbor From Hell” April 3 2026ABC’s 20/20 presents a powerful new true crime episode, The Neighbor From Hell, airing Friday, April 3, 2026, at 9/8c. The broadcast examines a heartbreaking case out of Ocala, Florida, where a neighborhood dispute escalated into deadly violence, leaving a community searching for answers.The episode centers on the fatal shooting of Ajike Owens, a mother of four, who was killed after approaching a neighbor’s home. What began as tensions between neighbors turned into a tragic confrontation that unfolded in front of children and shocked the local community.
